SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION RECORD FD-01. Fictional organisations, people, dates and facts. Not a real record.
Supplier-access exception, completed draft. Reference SYN-FD-01.
On 3 February 2031 Tarnwick Coatings Ltd requested read-only access to the coatings-specification library of Halvenmoor Instruments for four weeks. The supplier-access policy requires a completed security questionnaire before any access is granted. Tarnwick submitted the questionnaire on 30 January 2031, and on 31 January 2031 the security office recorded that section 6 (incident contacts) was incomplete. On 4 February 2031 the procurement lead, Imra Tevalle, approved a read-only exception because the specification was needed for a coating trial scheduled for 12 February 2031, and recorded that the security office would confirm section 6 by 14 February 2031. Access was granted on 5 February 2031 and ends on 4 March 2031.
